description: 8-week race-specific plan for experienced athletes with strong running (60+ min continuous) and functional fitness base. High-intensity HYROX preparation with competition weights and multiple brick workouts.

weeks.focus: Baseline assessment - test station PRs and establish running paces

days.cardioNotes: Conversational pace, establish baseline aerobic fitness

exercises.name: SkiErg - Max Distance Test
exercises.equipmentNeeded: SkiErg. If no SkiErg: rowing machine (same distance) or assault bike (2000m)
exercises.notes: Test max effort 1000m to establish baseline. Record time and avg watts.

exercises.name: Rowing - Max Distance Test
exercises.notes: Test max effort 1000m. Record time and avg pace/500m.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jumps
exercises.notes: Test set of 20 for time. Full burpee + broad jump each rep.

exercises.name: Wall Balls
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 9kg wall ball (men) / 6kg wall ball (women). If no wall ball target: thrusters with dumbbell
exercises.notes: Test set of 50 for time at competition weight. Record unbroken reps.

days.workoutStructure: 10 min easy warmup, 25 min tempo, 10 min easy cooldown

days.cardioNotes: Full rest or 20-30 min easy walk/bike

exercises.name: Sled Push - Max Distance Test
exercises.equipmentNeeded: Sled with 102kg (men) / 78kg (women). If no sled: prowler, heavy farmers carry, or resistance band sprints
exercises.notes: Test 50m sled push at competition weight for time. Record and assess power output.

exercises.name: Sled Pull - Max Distance Test
exercises.equipmentNeeded: Sled with 102kg (men) / 78kg (women). If no sled pull: heavy rope pulls or bent over rows
exercises.notes: Test 50m sled pull at competition weight for time. Focus on technique and pacing.

exercises.name: Farmers Carry - Max Distance Test
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 2x32kg kettlebells (men) / 2x24kg kettlebells (women). Use heaviest dumbbells/kettlebells available
exercises.notes: Test 200m farmers carry at competition weight for time. No drops.

exercises.name: Sandbag Lunges - Max Distance Test
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 20kg sandbag (both men/women). If no sandbag: goblet lunges with heavy dumbbell
exercises.notes: Test 100m sandbag lunges for time. Alternating legs, control descent.

days.cardioNotes: Easy aerobic pace, build endurance for 8km race distance

weeks.focus: Begin brick workout integration - transition practice

exercises.name: SkiErg
exercises.equipmentNeeded: SkiErg. If no SkiErg: rowing machine (same distance) or assault bike (2000m)
exercises.notes: 2 x 1000m with 3 min rest. Target race pace -5 seconds per 500m.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.equipmentNeeded: Sled with 102kg (men) / 78kg (women). If no sled: prowler, heavy farmers carry, or resistance band sprints
exercises.notes: 2 x 50m with 3 min rest. Focus on explosive power and pacing.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
exercises.equipmentNeeded: Sled with 102kg (men) / 78kg (women). If no sled pull: heavy rope pulls or bent over rows
exercises.notes: 2 x 50m with 3 min rest. Maintain steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jumps
exercises.notes: 2 x 40 reps with 3 min rest. Practice efficient movement pattern.

exercises.name: Rowing
exercises.notes: 2 x 1000m with 3 min rest. Target race pace.

exercises.name: Farmers Carry
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 2x32kg kettlebells (men) / 2x24kg kettlebells (women). Use heaviest dumbbells/kettlebells available
exercises.notes: 2 x 200m with 3 min rest. No drops, maintain posture.

exercises.name: Sandbag Lunges
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 20kg sandbag (both men/women). If no sandbag: goblet lunges with heavy dumbbell
exercises.notes: 2 x 100m with 3 min rest. Alternating legs, control pace.

exercises.name: Wall Balls
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 9kg wall ball (men) / 6kg wall ball (women). If no wall ball target: thrusters with dumbbell
exercises.notes: 2 x 75 reps with 3 min rest. Aim for minimal breaks.

exercises.name: Brick Sequence 1
exercises.notes: 1km run @ race pace + SkiErg 1000m + 1km run @ race pace. Rest 5 min between sets.

exercises.name: Brick Sequence 2
exercises.notes: 1km run @ race pace + Sled Push 50m + 1km run @ race pace. Rest 5 min between sets.

days.cardioNotes: Practice transitions - run to station to run. Focus on maintaining run pace after fatigue.
days.workoutStructure: 2 rounds of brick sequences with transition practice

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.notes: Heavy load, explosive concentric. Posterior chain focus.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.notes: Maintain quad strength for sled work.

exercises.name: Weighted Pullups
exercises.notes: Upper body pulling strength for sleds and rowing.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.notes: Each side. Anti-rotation core strength.

days.cardioNotes: Aerobic base building, slightly faster than easy pace

weeks.focus: High volume station work with multiple brick sessions

exercises.name: Full HYROX Station Circuit
exercises.notes: Complete all 8 stations in sequence: SkiErg 1000m, Sled Push 50m, Sled Pull 50m, Burpee Broad Jumps 80m, Rowing 1000m, Farmers Carry 200m, Sandbag Lunges 100m, Wall Balls 100 reps. Rest 2-3 min between stations. Record total time.

days.workoutStructure: Complete circuit format - all stations consecutively

exercises.name: Brick Sequence 1
exercises.notes: 1km run + SkiErg 1000m + Sled Push 50m + 1km run. No rest between elements.

exercises.name: Brick Sequence 2
exercises.notes: 1km run + Sled Pull 50m + Burpee Broad Jumps 40 reps + Rowing 1000m + 1km run. No rest between elements.

exercises.name: Brick Sequence 3
exercises.notes: 1km run + Farmers Carry 200m + Sandbag Lunges 100m + Wall Balls 75 reps + 1km run. No rest between elements.

days.cardioNotes: Race simulation format - practicing running under fatigue

exercises.name: Short Brick Intervals
exercises.notes: Each round: 1km run @ race pace + 2 stations (rotate through all 8 across 4 rounds). Rest 3-4 min between rounds. Focus on transition speed and maintaining run pace.

weeks.focus: Progressive overload on stations + race pace intervals

exercises.name: SkiErg Volume
exercises.equipmentNeeded: SkiErg. If no SkiErg: rowing machine (same distance) or assault bike (2000m)
exercises.notes: 3 x 1000m with 2 min rest. Target race pace each set.

exercises.name: Sled Push Volume
exercises.equipmentNeeded: Sled with 102kg (men) / 78kg (women). If no sled: prowler, heavy farmers carry, or resistance band sprints
exercises.notes: 4 x 50m with 2 min rest. Explosive starts, maintain speed.

exercises.name: Sled Pull Volume
exercises.equipmentNeeded: Sled with 102kg (men) / 78kg (women). If no sled pull: heavy rope pulls or bent over rows
exercises.notes: 4 x 50m with 2 min rest. Smooth rhythm, no jerking.

exercises.name: Rowing Volume
exercises.notes: 3 x 1000m with 2 min rest. Focus on pace consistency.

days.workoutStructure: 10 min warmup, 6 x 1km @ race pace with 90 sec jog recovery, 10 min cooldown

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jumps Volume
exercises.notes: 3 x 80 reps with 3 min rest. Full distance (80m). Maintain rhythm.

exercises.name: Farmers Carry Volume
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 2x32kg kettlebells (men) / 2x24kg kettlebells (women). Use heaviest dumbbells/kettlebells available
exercises.notes: 3 x 200m with 2 min rest. No drops, upright posture.

exercises.name: Sandbag Lunges Volume
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 20kg sandbag (both men/women). If no sandbag: goblet lunges with heavy dumbbell
exercises.notes: 3 x 100m with 2 min rest. Alternating legs, deep lunges.

exercises.name: Wall Balls Volume
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 9kg wall ball (men) / 6kg wall ball (women). If no wall ball target: thrusters with dumbbell
exercises.notes: 3 x 100 reps with 2 min rest. Practice pacing strategy.

days.cardioNotes: Build to tempo pace in final 15 min
days.workoutStructure: 60 min easy, 15 min build to tempo pace

weeks.focus: Peak volume week - multiple brick sessions

days.cardioNotes: Recovery pace before hard training days

exercises.name: Complete HYROX Station Sequence
exercises.equipmentNeeded: All HYROX equipment at competition weights
exercises.notes: Time trial all 8 stations in order with minimal rest between stations (30-60 sec). SkiErg 1000m → Sled Push 50m → Sled Pull 50m → Burpee Broad Jumps 80m → Rowing 1000m → Farmers Carry 200m → Sandbag Lunges 100m → Wall Balls 100 reps. Record total time and splits.

days.workoutStructure: Continuous circuit, minimal rest between stations

exercises.name: Full Brick Sequence
exercises.notes: Each round: 1km run + 2 stations (rotating through all 8). Round 1: Run+SkiErg+Sled Push. Round 2: Run+Sled Pull+Burpees. Round 3: Run+Row+Farmers. Round 4: Run+Sandbag+Wall Balls. Rest 4 min between rounds.

exercises.name: Short Intense Bricks
exercises.notes: 5 rounds: 800m run @ race pace + 1 station (rotate through 5 different stations). Rest 3 min between rounds. Focus on transition efficiency and pace maintenance.

weeks.focus: Maintain intensity, slight volume reduction for recovery

exercises.name: SkiErg
exercises.equipmentNeeded: SkiErg. If no SkiErg: rowing machine (same distance) or assault bike (2000m)
exercises.notes: 2 x 1000m with 3 min rest. Race pace effort.

exercises.name: Sled Complex
exercises.notes: 2 rounds: Sled Push 50m + Sled Pull 50m. Rest 3 min between rounds.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jumps
exercises.notes: 2 x 60 reps with 3 min rest. Maintain efficiency.

exercises.name: Rowing
exercises.notes: 2 x 1000m with 3 min rest. Target race splits.

exercises.name: Wall Balls
exercises.notes: 2 x 75 reps with 3 min rest. Practice unbroken sets.

exercises.name: Moderate Brick Session
exercises.notes: 3 rounds: 1km run + 2-3 stations. Rest 5 min between rounds. Focus on smooth transitions and consistent pacing.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: Heavy load, maintain posterior chain strength.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.notes: Moderate load, quad emphasis.

exercises.name: Weighted Pushups
exercises.notes: Upper body pressing strength.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
exercises.notes: Each side. Full body stability.

weeks.focus: Full race simulation - test race strategy and pacing

exercises.name: SkiErg
exercises.notes: 1 x 1000m at race pace. Dial in strategy.

exercises.name: Rowing
exercises.notes: 1 x 1000m at race pace. Practice pacing.

exercises.name: Wall Balls
exercises.notes: 1 x 100 reps. Test break strategy (unbroken vs sets).

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jumps
exercises.notes: 1 x 80 reps (full 80m). Confirm pacing rhythm.

exercises.name: Complete HYROX Race Simulation
exercises.notes: FULL RACE FORMAT: 1km run → SkiErg 1000m → 1km run → Sled Push 50m → 1km run → Sled Pull 50m → 1km run → Burpee Broad Jumps 80m → 1km run → Rowing 1000m → 1km run → Farmers Carry 200m → 1km run → Sandbag Lunges 100m → 1km run → Wall Balls 100 reps → 1km run. TOTAL: 8km running + 8 stations. Record total time, all splits, nutrition/hydration strategy, transition times, and how you felt at each stage.

days.cardioNotes: CRITICAL WORKOUT: Full race simulation with all equipment, distances, and weights. Test race day nutrition, pacing strategy, and transitions. This is your dress rehearsal.
days.workoutStructure: Complete race format - 8 x 1km runs interspersed with 8 stations

days.cardioNotes: Complete rest after race simulation. Review performance, identify adjustments needed.

weeks.focus: Race week - maintain sharpness, maximize recovery

exercises.name: SkiErg
exercises.notes: 1 x 500m easy. Just feel the movement, no intensity.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.notes: 1 x 25m at race weight. Movement prep only.

exercises.name: Wall Balls
exercises.notes: 1 x 30 reps easy. Just touch the equipment.

days.cardioNotes: Easy with 4 short strides to maintain leg speed
days.workoutStructure: 20 min easy, then 4x20sec strides at race pace

days.cardioNotes: Very easy run with a few pickups
days.workoutStructure: 15 min easy, then 3x15sec pickups at race pace

days.cardioNotes: Execute your race plan. Start controlled on first 1km, settle into rhythm. Attack the stations you're strongest at, be smart on weaker ones. Trust your training. You're ready!
days.workoutStructure: 10 min warmup (easy jog + dynamic stretches + 2-3 strides), then RACE: 8 x 1km runs with 8 stations
